messages:
deploy-bot: Starting deploy to production
  env=production
  tag=v1.23.0
  commit=4f2c9b2
  canary=100%

ci-bot: CI gate failed — 3 checks failing: integration-tests, lint, dependency-security-scan

ci-bot: Failing jobs excerpt:
```
  integration-tests/payment-e2e — timeout at step 23/60
  lint — 1 error (src/payments/processor.go: unused var)
  dependency-security-scan — high severity: libxml2 2.9.10 (CVE-xxxx)
```

andrew: on it, pulling the integration logs now

samira: looks like payment-e2e hit the flaky timeout again :/ saw similar yesterday at 10:12pm

maria: is payment-e2e marked flaky in CI? I thought we quarantined it last month

jen: quick reminder — policy blocks manual override of CI gate for prod without PM+security signoff :no_entry_sign:

andrew: understood. Can we rerun just the failing suites?

deploy-bot: To rerun CI for this deploy: `/deploy retry 1803001234` or trigger jobs in CircleCI -> workflows -> deploy-canary. Note: rerun will not bypass dependency-security-scan.

samira: I'm kicking off a targeted rerun for integration-tests/payment-e2e now — will post results. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

andrew: if payment-e2e is flaky and we hit security-scan failure too, maybe safer to pin back to v1.22.9 and ship a hotfix later

maria: agree. Ops: can we get a temporary rollback window?

ops-oncall: I can approve a 1-hour emergency change window for a rollback/pin. If CI doesn't clear in T+30m we'll initiate rollback to v1.22.9. Logging approval here for audit.

andrew: creating rollback PR (cherry-pick commit 9b8a3c into release/v1.22.x) — https://git.redwood/repo/pulls/1245

ci-bot: Rerun started by samira — integration-tests/payment-e2e (rerun #2)

samira: local run passed for payment-e2e (CI runner still warming, fingers crossed) :crossed_fingers:

ci-bot: Update: integration-tests passed on rerun. Lint still failing: `src/payments/processor.go: line 112: unused variable 'tmp'`

andrew: taking the lint fix in hotfix PR, will push shortly

deploy-bot: New blocker: dependency-security-scan failed — libxml2 flagged with high severity CVE.

maria: that's a blockers — security needs to sign off or we patch the dependency. Anyone aware of a quick patch?

samira: build shows the transitive bump came in from `xml-parser` v3.2. I'll try pinning `xml-parser` to v3.1.9 and re-run scans.

jen: per policy, security-scan failures must be resolved before releasing. No manual bypass. Recording that manual override was considered and denied. :writing_hand:

andrew: opening hotfix PR to pin dependency + lint fix: https://git.redwood/repo/pulls/1246 — will request security review

ops-oncall: If security review can't clear within 2 hours, proceed with rollback at T+30m as approved.

samira: pin PR merged to branch `hotfix/dep-pin-lint` and triggered CI. :rocket:

ci-bot: dependency-security-scan — running.

ci-bot: dependency-security-scan — PASSED

ci-bot: lint — PASSED

ci-bot: All CI gates green for deploy 1803001234.

deploy-bot: Deploy can proceed — unblocked. Continuing rollout to production (tag=v1.23.0 commit=4f2c9b2).

andrew: thanks everyone — will follow up in the release notes with the dependency pin and flaky test flagged for quarantining.

maria: noted — adding to post-release action items: quarantine payment-e2e + root cause for libxml2 bump.

jen: audit note: attempted manual override prevented; change window used for rollback planning but not executed. :white_check_mark:

deploy-bot: Final state: deploy succeeded after CI gate rerun and hotfix.

andrew: closing thread, will update release notes and changelog.
